## Scope check

DroidNix only ships features that are implemented and verified. Please note
whether this is:

- [ ] A device compatibility report (include device, Android, kernel, Magisk)
- [ ] A change to Phase 1 functionality
- [ ] Phase 2 (display/input) or later

See `docs/FEATURES.md` and `docs/ROADMAP.md` before opening this request.
